display.title: Episode 432: The Island of Treasures (Rosh Chodesh Tammuz)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's show before Rosh Chodesh Tammuz: why sinas chinam cost us the Beis HaMikdash and Ahavas Yisroel will bring it back, Shema with a first-grade class, and the parable of the Island of Treasures.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week before Rosh Chodesh Tammuz 5750. Uncle Yossi explains that the sad events of Tammuz teach us what caused them: the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed because of sinas chinam, hatred for no reason. The cure is Ahavas Yisroel, helping every Jew with his physical and spiritual needs, which is what Tzivos Hashem is all about and what will bring Moshiach. After the Hakochainik march, a first-grade class from Beis Yaakov of Boro Park recites the Shema, and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time explains the Mishnah in Pirkei Avos (4:16) that this world is like a hallway before the banquet hall. A shipwrecked man named Yisrael is crowned king of an island and spends its entire treasury beautifying it, only to learn that he must leave the day the next castaway arrives, taking nothing with him. The island is this world, the treasures are the mitzvos, and every child is the king who can send treasures ahead to the World to Come. The show closes with a sponsor message and Shabbos candle-lighting times.
display.lesson: This world is a hallway to the World to Come: use your time here to send ahead treasures of Torah and mitzvos, and love every Jew without reason.
